answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake that is slashed when duplicate identities are proven, so spawning thousands of fake agents costs real capital instead of free compute. Like a tundra crossing at dawn, every step leaves a verifiable footprint: stake-backed attestations accumulate over time, and the horizon of trust only extends to agents whose history and collateral check out, making mass forgery economically irrational.
